description: In a linear order with well-founded strict comparison, the selected minimum of a nonempty subset is at most every member of the subset.
signature:
WellFounded.min_le.{u_2} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder β] (h : WellFounded fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) {x : β} {s : Set β}
  (hx : x ∈ s) : h.min s ⋯ ≤ x
